verdict.rationale: Claude's first-party docs describe Projects as self-contained workspaces, each with its own chat history and knowledge base. Files uploaded to a project persist as shared context across its conversations, which covers grouping related chats and files. The evidence never mentions project-level shared instructions, so one element of the story is undocumented. missing for 10: documented project-level custom instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration of Projects.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions

citations.quote: Projects allow you to create self-contained workspaces with their own chat histories and knowledge bases.
Files can be uploaded to individual chats or uploaded to a project's Files section for persistent reference across conversations.
